messages.content: "Can you help me plan my day? I want to start from my home in New York and go to a chess club named 'Knight Gambit' located in Boston. I want to take the fastest route. After that, I want to go to another chess club named 'Rook Corner' in Philadelphia, again taking the fastest route. Finally, I want to return home, but this time I want to take the shortest route. Can you also provide me with the details of the events hosted by both chess clubs?"

function.name: chess_club_details_find
function.description: Provides details about a chess club, including location. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

name.description: The name of the chess club.

city.description: The city in which the chess club is located.

event.description: The event hosted by the club.

function.name: route_planner_calculate_route
function.description: Determines the best route between two points. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

start.description: The starting point of the journey.

method.description: The method to use when calculating the route (default is 'fastest').

message.reasoning:
We need to call functions:

1) Get chess club details for Knight Gambit in Boston.

2) Route planner calculate route from New York to Boston via Knight Gambit? Actually we just need route from home to club; maybe no intermediate stops needed. But user wants to travel from NY to Boston then to Philly then back home. So we can compute routes separately:

Route 1: Start: New York, Destination: Boston, Method: fastest.

But they might want to include the club as stop? Not necessary.

Then second route: Boston to Philadelphia, fastest.

Third route: Philadelphia to New York, shortest.

Also get details of events at each club.

So first call chess_club_details_find for Knight Gambit, city Boston.

Second call chess_club_details_find for Rook Corner, city Philadelphia.

Then route calculations accordingly.

Let's do calls sequentially.

First call chess_club_details_find(name="Knight Gambit", city="Boston").

Second call chess_club_details_find(name="Rook Corner", city="Philadelphia").

Third call route_planner_calculate_route(start="New York", destination="Boston", method="fastest").

Fourth call route_planner_calculate_route(start="Boston", destination="Philadelphia", method="fastest").

Fifth call route_planner_calculate_route(start="Philadelphia", destination="New York", method="shortest").

Return results combined into answer.
